Jabir b. Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "The fragrance of Paradise is present, and its scent can be perceived from a distance of five hundred years."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى عكلنه كان يقول هو وأصحابه امن لم تنهه صلاته عن الفحثاء والمنكر لم يزدد بها من الله إلا بعدا
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: "He and his companions have faith, for their prayer does not divert them from obedience to God; they do not increase in God's favor except with patience."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبسي عكلظإته قال أأهل المعروف في الدنيا هم أهل المعروف ني الآخرة وأهل المنكر ني الدنيا هم أهل المنكر في الآخرة
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "Are those who are known for good deeds in this world, also known for good deeds in the Hereafter? And are those who are known for evil deeds in this world, also known for evil deeds in the Hereafter?"

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر نال معاهدا لم يجد (٢١ بن زيد عن النبى علإنة من نتل ريح الجنة وإن ريحها يوجد من مسيرة خمسائة عام (. (٩٥٧١ جابر
text_en: Jabir said, "I made a covenant with the Prophet ﷺ that I would not claim to have seen anything from the blessings of Paradise unless it was true. He said to me, 'Indeed, the scent of Paradise is carried on the wind for five hundred years' journey."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر
text_en:
Jabir reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"The best of my ummah is my generation, then those who come after them."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جسابر بن زيد عن النبي علإنة تال اليحسولن بين أحدكم وبين الجنة بعد أن يراها كف من دم مسلم يهرقها
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "Between one of you and Paradise is only a distance which can be covered by a walking camel between two watering places, after he has seen it being irrigated with the blood of a Muslim."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى ويكلته نال »و الذي نفسسي بيحده لايدخل الجنة الا من يأمن جاره بوائقه ( قال جابر ظلمه و غشمه . (٩٦٠١ جابر بن زيد عن النبى علإانة قال امن أعان على قتل مؤمن بشطر كلمة جاء يوم القيامة مكتوباً بين عينيه آيسا ( من دحمة الله «.
text_en:
Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "And he who does not safeguard his neighbor's rights will not enter Paradise except by being given respite." Jabir said, "He was oppressed and wronged."

Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "Whoever safeguards his neighbor's rights is as if he has aided in the killing of a believer with half a word. He will come on the Day of Resurrection with 'I am innocent' written between his eyes."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عسن النبي عكلإنة أنه قطع سارقاً نلما قطعه تال له »إن يمينك سبقتك إك النار نإن تبت رد الله عليك يمينك وإلا يتبع آخر جسدك أوله « . (٩٦٢١ جابر بن زيد عن النبي عكلنة قال »قال ربكم خلقت الجنة عرضها السموات والارض وأقسم ربنا لايدخلها قاطع لرحمه ولامدمن خمر ولا الديوث يعني الذي يقود أهله
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "If your right hand takes something, then it is for you to give it back. If it precedes you in taking, then say: 'My Lord, I have been wronged.' If you are given back what was taken from you, then know that Allah has returned your right to you. And if not, then the last part of your body will follow." (Reported by Jabir ibn Zayd)

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى علنة تال يجيء أتوام يوم القيامة ومعهم من الحسنات أمثال جبال تهامة نجعلها الله هباء " ويصيرهم إلى النار تال سالم مولى أبى حذيفة حلهم (نا يارسول الله خفت أن اكون منهم نقال رسول اللسه »١( خ آيس خ منثورا
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: "There will come to the Day of Judgment a people who are abundant in good deeds, like the mountains of Tihamah. We will make them like dust (in terms of reward) on that day." And it was said to Salim, the mawla of Abu Hudhayfah: "O Salim, we fear that you may be among them, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I am afraid that I may be among those who are scattered (i.e., lost) on the Day of Judgment.'"

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبي عللة نال امن تعلم العلم العلماء أو يماري )ا( ليباهى به به السفهاء أو يصرف به وجوه الناس إليه فهو في جهنم (. (٩٦٥١ جابر بن زيد عن النبي عكلنة قال »ألا أخبركم بأول الناس في النار ( تالوا ومن هو قال افاسق قرأ كتاب الله ولم * يارسول الله يدع منه شيئا «. _
text_en:
Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "A scholar who seeks knowledge and teaches it to others, but does not guide people with it, nor prevents the foolish from deviating, will be in Hell." (9:65)

Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "I will inform you of the first of people to enter Hell. They are those who like to sit with the foolish and divert the faces of people towards them. He is in Hell."

Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "Do I not tell you about the first of people to be cast into Hell? It will be those who read the Book of Allah but do not act upon it, nor does Allah's Messenger take anything from them."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن النبي ... قال ألا أخبركم بأول الناس في النار
text_en: Abu Ubaidah reported from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Prophet said: "Shall I inform you of the first people to enter the Fire?"

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله علنة نال امن صلى صلاة ذمة الله الصبح نهو ي فلايطلبنك الله ي شيء من ذمته فيكبك به على وجهك في النار ( .
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "I have been made to fear that you will be asked about your prayer, so perform it as a duty for God. Do not seek to beautify it in front of people, for if you do, God will not accept anything from you except with a frown on your face."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله علله قال االحياء من الايمان والإيمان في الجنة والبذاء من الجفاء والجفاء في النار«٠ )٩٦٨( جابر بن زيد عن النبى علانة قال اتحشر الظلمة وأعوانهم على بري تلم آو بمدة ليقة _)ا( فني النار .
text_en:
Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "Life is from faith, and faith is in Paradise. The root of evil is arrogance, and arrogance is in Hell."

Note:

* "الحياء" (al-ḥayāʾ) refers to a sense of modesty or shame
* "الإيمان" (al-imān) refers to faith or belief
* "البذاء" (al-baḏāʾ) is an archaic term for arrogance or haughtiness, often translated as "pride"
* "الجفاء" (al-jafāʾ) refers to arrogance or haughtiness

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى ... الجفاء من الجفاء والجفاء في النار
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet Muhammad said: " Stinginess is from stinginess and there is a place for stinginess in Hell."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جسابر بن زيد عن النب عتلند اإن الرجل ليتكلم بالكلمة من سخط الله مايظن أنها بلغت مابلغت فيهوى بها نى النار سبعين خريفا ( . )٩٧٠( جابر ابن زيد عن النبى يللةكسان يقرل »من غسثنا فليس منا ومن حمل علينا السلاح فليس منا ومن انتهب مالنا فليس منا ومن لم يوقر كبيرنا ويرحم صغيرنا فليس منا ومن ضرب الخدود وشق الجيوب ودعا بدعوى الجاهلية فليس منا( . (٩٧١١ جابر بن زيد عن النبى يعكلإانة قال أتى عريفاً آو كاهنا امن آو ساحرا نصدقه فيما يقول فهو بريء مما أنزل الله على محمد علنه _٩٧٢ جابر بن زيد عن النبي يكلن قال لكعب بن عجرة أعيذك بالله من أمراء يكونون مسن بعدي من دخسل عليهم فأعانهم على ظلمهم آو صدقهم في قولهم فليس مني ولسست منه ولايرد على حوضي (
text_en:
Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "A man who speaks a word out of anger, thinking it has reached its target, will be brought to account for seventy years." 

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "Whoever among us is given to usury, he is not from us. Whoever takes up arms against us, he is not from us. Whoever seizes our wealth, he is not from us. And whoever does not respect our elders or show mercy to our young ones, he is not from us. And whoever strikes faces and tears open bellies, calling for the practices of pre-Islamic ignorance, he is not from us."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "If a soothsayer, sorcerer, or astrologer comes to you with his claims, believe him in what he says. He will be exempt from the punishment Allah has decreed for Muhammad and his community." 

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "I seek refuge with Allah from my governors who will come after me. If they are unjust, I will not support them. And if they speak the truth, I will not oppose them."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر ابن زيد عن النبى ... من غسثنا فليس منا
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever among us (i.e., Muslims) is afflicted with a calamity, then he is not from us."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى ... من حمل علينا السلاح فليس منا
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet Muhammad said: "Whoever bears arms against us is not one of us."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبي ... أتى عريفاً آو كاهنا امن آو ساحرا نصدقه فيما يقول فهو بريء مما أنزل الله على محمد علنه
text_en:
Jabir b. Zayd reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: "If a soothsayer, or a priest, or an astrologer comes to you and asks for money in exchange for what he says, then he is free from responsibility for what was revealed upon Muhammad."

Note: I translated "عريفاً" as "soothsayer", which refers to someone who claims to have supernatural knowledge or the ability to predict the future through various means.

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن رسسول الله علان قسال »من حسقر مسسلماً فليسس )ا( الليقة القطعة من الصوف تجمل فى الدواة لاصلاح مدادما وألاق للدواة جعل لها الليقة او اصلح مدادما ابو اسحاق قوله عريفا وفى بعض النسخ عرافا ومما بمعنى واحد ومو المنجم والكامن وتيل العراف يخبر عن الماضى والكامن يخبر عن اماضى والمستقبل » بمسلم (.
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "If a Muslim is stingy, let him give his share from the wool to the weavers for their repair and maintenance. The weaver will either make it into something beautiful or improve its condition."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله وكلفا قال اأبرأ إلى الله من القدرية أبرأ إلى الله من المرجئة بريء الله منهما ورسوله . (٩٧٥١ جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله عكللاه قال العن الله الواشمة والمتس وشمة والواصلة والمستوصلة والنامصة وامستنمصة والواشرة والمستوشرة والمانع الصدقة (
text_en:
Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "I am more free from accountability to Allah regarding the Qadariyyah and the Murji'ah than these two groups." 

He also said: "May Allah curse those who withhold zakāh, those who are given zakāh but do not accept it, those who give zakāh reluctantly, those who give zakāh unwillingly, those who take zakāt by force, those who refuse to pay zakāt, and those who prevent people from paying zakāt."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله ... العن الله الواشمة والمتس وشمة والواصلة والمستوصلة والنامصة وامستنمصة والواشرة والمستوشرة والمانع الصدقة
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "The one who is stingy with his Zakāt (obligatory almsgiving) and the one who is slow in giving it, and the one who gives it reluctantly, and the one who gives it unwillingly, and the one who delays it, and the one who does not give it at all - may Allah curse them."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى وعتلتة تال العن الله الخمر وعاصرها ومعتصرها وحاملها والمحمولة إليه وشاربها وساقيها وبائعها ومبتاعها وآكل ثمنها. )٩٧٧( جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله كلله تال »لسعن الله من أحدث ني الإسلام حدثاً أو آوى محدثاً لايقبل منه صرف ولا عدل ٩٧٨١٠( جابر بن زيد عنه عليه السلام امن ادعى إلى غير أبيه أو تولى غير مواليه فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين ولايقبل منه صرف ولا عدل (. (٩٧٩١ جابر بن زيد عنه عليه السلام امن حالت شفاعته دون حد من حدود الله نقد ضاد الله نى ملكه وخاض في سخطه وإن لعنة الله تتابع عليه إلى يوم القيامسة ٣ ٩٨٠- جابر بن زيد عنه عليه السلام قال »لعن الله قوماً اتخذوا قبور انبيائهم مساجد«. )٩٨١( جابر بن زيد عن النبى علنة تال املعون من آذى المسلمين في طريقهم ملعون من آتى بهيمة .
text_en:
Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "The intoxicant is forbidden by Allah, and its drinker, carrier, and one who holds it for another are all cursed. Its seller and buyer, and one who consumes its price are also cursed."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "Anyone who innovates something in Islam that is not from Allah will have no share in what I have been given, nor any right to intercession on the Day of Resurrection."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "Beware of anyone who calls to a deity other than Allah or takes care of someone other than his relatives. May the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people be upon him. He will have no share in what I have been given, nor any right to intercession on the Day of Resurrection."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "The intercession of anyone who is responsible for a sin that prevents them from receiving Allah's mercy will not be accepted by Allah. They will be punished with a punishment from Allah, and His wrath will follow them until the Day of Resurrection."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "May Allah curse those who take the graves of prophets as mosques."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "Anyone who harms Muslims on their way is cursed. Anyone who gives something to someone for harm against a Muslim is also cursed."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله ... كلله تال »لسعن الله من أحدث ني الإسلام حدثاً أو آوى محدثاً لايقبل منه صرف ولا عدل
text_en: Abu Ubaidah related from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Messenger of Allah said: "Allah's pleasure is for whoever introduces a new matter in Islam, or follows a innovator, his reward will not be accepted and he will not be considered just."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى ... من ادعى إلى غير أبيه أو تولى غير مواليه فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين ولايقبل منه صرف ولا عدل
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet Muhammad said: "He who claims inheritance from someone other than his father or takes care of someone else's dependents incurs the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. No charity or justice will be accepted from him."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عنه عليه السلام ... من حالت شفاعته دون حد من حدود الله نقد ضاد الله نى ملكه وخاض في سخطه وإن لعنة الله تتابع عليه إلى يوم القيامة
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: "If a person's intercession is accepted, it will be for one who has been punished by Allah to the extent of His wrath, and he will have been afflicted with His anger. And if Allah's curse descends upon him, it will continue to pursue him until the Day of Resurrection."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عنه عليه السلام ... قال »لعن الله قوماً اتخذوا قبور انبيائهم مساجد«
text_en: Abu Ubaidah related from Jabir ibn Zayd (may Allah be pleased with him) that he said: "God has cursed a people who have made the graves of their prophets into mosques."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن النبى ... علنة تال املعون من آذى المسلمين في طريقهم ملعون من
text_en: Abu Ubayda reported from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Prophet said: "Cursed is he who harms a Muslim in their path, cursed is he."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله ظلا وذكره عنه غيره آنه عليه السلام نال إذا وضع الميت في نبره وسوي عليه نإنه يسمع نعال القوم حين ينصرفون عنه لانه حمل من بيته وروحه مع الملائكة فإذا وضع في قبره يأتيه ملكان أصواتهما كالرعد القاصف وأبصارهما كالبرق الخاطف فيقعدانه فيقولان ياهذا من ربك وما دينك ومن نبيك نإن كان مؤمناً قال الله ربي والاسلام دينى ومحمد نبي فيقال له على هذا أحييت وعليه أمت وعليه تبعث أنظر عن يسارك فيفتح له باب فى تبره إلى النار نيقال له هذا منزلسك عصيت الله نأما إذ قل أطعته نانظر عن يمينك فيفتح له باب نى نبره الى الجنة نيدخل عليه برد منزله ولذته فيريد أن ينهض فيقال له لم يأت أوان ذلك م سعيدا م نومة العسروس نما شىء أحب إليه من نيام الساعة حتى يصير أهل ومسال وإلى جنة )ا( إلسى النعيم وأما إذا كان كافرا فيقعدانه فيقولان من ربك فيقول ماأدري فيقولان ماتقول فى هذا الرجل يعنى محمداً يلظتة فيقول كنت أنول فيه كما ا يقسول الناس فيقولان لا آدريت ولا تليت على هذا عثت وعليه مت وعليه تبعث أنظر (٢ عن يمينك فيفتح ه باب من الجنة نيقال له هذا منزلك لو أطعت الله نأما إذ ند عصيته فانظر عن ئىمالك فيفتح له باب من قبره إلى جهنم نيدخل عليه غم منزله وأذاه وماشىء أبعض إلي من نيام الساعة فيصير الى العذاب . جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله عللاه أنه تسال الايزنى الزانى حين يزنى وهو مؤمن ولايسرق السارق حين يسرق وهو مؤمن ولايشرب الخمر حين يشربها وهو مؤمن فإن تاب تابً الله عليه ( ٩٨٤- جسابر بن زيد عن النبى علنه نسال »إن أمتي سيكفرون من بًعدي أما إنهم لايعبدون شمسا ولاقمرا ولاحجراً ولاوثناً ولكنهم يراؤن بأعمالهم ٠ )٩٨٥ جابر بن زيد عن النبى يتلإانةه تال ايصير الرياء نفاقا والنفاق أخفى في أمنى من دبيب الذر ( . )٩٨٦( جابر بن زيد عن النبى عتلتة قال ايدعى المرائي يوم القيامة باربعة أسماء على رؤس الخلائق ياغادر يافاجر ياخاسر بطل عمل وخسر آجرك نخذ أجرك ممن عملت له فلا أجر لك عندي يامرائي ٠ )٩٨٧( جابر بن زيد عن النبى علنه أن رجلاً أتاه فقال يارسول الله أتصدق بصدقة ألتمس بها الحمد والاجر نقال رسول الله لظتة الاشريك نه تعمالى ( فأنزل الله تعالى هذه الآية افمن كان يرجو لقاء ربه فليعمل عملا صالحا ولايشرك بعبادة ربه أحدا ( _ ٩٨٨ جسابر بن زيد عن رسول الله لإنة تال »من قبل الله منه حسنة عصمه إى آخر الأبد . جابر بن زيد عن مسعاذ بن جبل رضى الله عنه كسان يمشى فسي بعسض الطريق وهو ينحي الآذى عن الطريق فسرآه رجل
text_en:
Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "When a person is placed in his grave, and it is levelled for him, he hears the sound of the people's footsteps as they depart from him, because he has been taken by the angels from his family and soul. If he was a believer, two angels with voices like thunder and vision like lightning will sit beside him and say: 'O so-and-so, what is your Lord?' He will say: 'My Lord is Allah.' They will ask: 'What is your religion?' He will say: 'Islam.' They will ask: 'Who is your Prophet?' He will say: 'Muhammad.' They will say to him: 'On this basis, you have been resurrected and on this basis, your community has been resurrected. And on this basis, you will be brought back to life.' Then they will look at his left side and a door from the grave will open up to Paradise, saying: 'This is your abode. If only you had obeyed Allah.' They will say: 'Look to your right,' and a door from the grave will open up to Hell, saying: 'This is your abode. You disobeyed Allah.'

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "A person who is an adulterer, even if he is a believer, does not steal when he steals as a believer, nor does he drink wine when he drinks it as a believer. If he repents, then Allah will forgive him."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "My community will be tested in their deeds, and they will be shown to be hypocrites. Hypocrisy is more hidden in the hearts of the secure than the buzzing of a mosquito."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "On the Day of Resurrection, I will call out to the hypocrites by four names, and they will be gathered from among the people. They will be asked: 'What is your Lord?' They will say: 'We do not know.' They will be asked: 'What is your religion?' They will say: 'We do not know.' They will be asked: 'Who is your Prophet?' They will say: 'We do not know.' I will say to them: 'You have been brought here, and you have no reward with me.'"

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "Allah has forbidden for me the Fire, and it is not permissible for anyone who has faith in me to be taken to the Fire."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "My community will be tested in their deeds, and they will be shown to be hypocrites. Hypocrisy is more hidden in the hearts of the secure than the buzzing of a mosquito."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "On the Day of Resurrection, I will call out to the hypocrites by four names, and they will be gathered from among the people. They will be asked: 'What is your Lord?' They will say: 'We do not know.' They will be asked: 'What is your religion?' They will say: 'We do not know.' They will be asked: 'Who is your Prophet?' They will say: 'We do not know.' I will say to them: 'You have been brought here, and you have no reward with me.'"

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "Allah has forbidden for me the Fire, and it is not permissible for anyone who has faith in me to be taken to the Fire."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that Sa'd bin Jubayr (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "A person was walking on the road when he saw a man lying down on the side of the road, and he moved his shoulder away from the road. A man passed by and said to him: 'You have done well.'"

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله عللاه أنه تسال الايزنى الزانى حين يزنى وهو مؤمن ولايسرق السارق حين يسرق وهو مؤمن ولايشرب الخمر حين يشربها وهو مؤمن فإن تاب تابً الله عليه (
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The adulterer is not asked to repent when he commits adultery, nor is the thief asked to repent when he steals, nor is the drunkard asked to repent when he drinks. But if he repents, then Allah will accept his repentance."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جسابر بن زيد عن النبى علنه نسال »إن أمتي سيكفرون من بًعدي أما إنهم لايعبدون شمسا ولاقمرا ولاحجراً ولاوثناً ولكنهم يراؤن بأعمالهم ٠ )٩٨٥ جابر بن زيد عن النبى يتلإانةه تال ايصير الرياء نفاقا والنفاق أخفى في أمنى من دبيب الذر ( . )٩٨٦( جابر بن زيد عن النبى عتلتة قال ايدعى المرائي يوم القيامة باربعة أسماء على رؤس الخلائق ياغادر يافاجر ياخاسر بطل عمل وخسر آجرك نخذ أجرك ممن عملت له فلا أجر لك عندي يامرائي ٠ )٩٨٧( جابر بن زيد عن النبى علنه أن رجلاً أتاه فقال يارسول الله أتصدق بصدقة ألتمس بها الحمد والاجر نقال رسول الله لظتة الاشريك نه تعمالى ( فأنزل الله تعالى هذه الآية افمن كان يرجو لقاء ربه فليعمل عملا صالحا ولايشرك بعبادة ربه أحدا ( _
text_en:
Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "My nation will be destroyed by my followers. They do not worship the sun or the moon or any star, nor do they associate partners with Allah; but they pretend to be righteous through their deeds."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "The hypocrisy will conceal itself in the hearts of the safe ones (those who are secure from harm) like a flea on an animal's back."

Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "A hypocrite will be called to account by Allah on the Day of Resurrection by four names, and he will leave with nothing. He will be asked: 'What did you do?' He will say: 'I was a mujtahid (one who strives to do good) in my deeds.' He will be told: 'You were not a mujtahid; rather you were a fajir (wicked person). You were a khassir (a loser) in your actions and a hathir (a loser) in your reward. Take your reward from the one for whom you did good, for I have no reward for you.'"

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن النبى ... ولكنهم يراؤن بأعمالهم
text_en: Abu Ubaidah reported from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Prophet said: "But they will be deceived by their deeds."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن النبى ... وليسرأه في أمنى من دبيب الذر
text_en: Abu Ubaidah reported from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "I have been given relief in my heart, greater than the relief of a camel being released from its load."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن النبى ... ياغادر يافاجر ياخاسر بطل عمل وخسر آجرك نخذ أجرك ممن عملت له
text_en:
Abu Ubaidah reported from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Prophet said: "He who leaves a good deed will be rewarded for it, and he who leaves a bad deed will have his reward taken away from him."

Note: The phrase "أجرك" in the hadith is a reference to one's reward or recompense (a'jir) in the hereafter.

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جسابر بن زيد عن رسول الله لإنة تال »من قبل الله منه حسنة عصمه إى آخر الأبد .
text_en: Jasabir ibn Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "From Allah is a good deed which He takes back from him, and it is not removed until the end of his life."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن مسعاذ بن جبل رضى الله عنه كسان يمشى فسي بعسض الطريق وهو ينحي الآذى عن الطريق فسرآه رجل يصنع ذلك نأتبل يصنع صنعه فالتفت إليه معاذ وقال إنما صنعت لشىء بلغنى ولاي شيء صنعت ماصنعت فقال الرجل نأحببت أن أصنع كصنيعك )ا( رأيتك تصنع ذلك نسال نعم رسول الله علنة يقول سمعت من نحى عن طريق المسلمين أذى كتب الله له حسنة ومن كستب الله له حسنة أدخله الجنة ( ثم تلا معاذ »إن الله لايظلم مثقال ذرة وإن تك حسنة يضاعفها ويؤت من لدنه أجرا عظيما. )٩٩٠( جابر بن زيد عن النبى يقول ااتقوا النار ولو بشق تمرة نمن اتقى النار ولو بشق تمرة وقاه الله ثىر مااتقى (.
text_en:
Ja'bir ibn Zayd reported from Mu'adh ibn Jabal (may Allah be pleased with him) that a man was walking on the road and he would move an obstacle out of the way for another person. Another man saw this and said, "I will do the same as you have done." So Mu'adh turned to him and said, "I did it for something I was informed about, but I did not do what I did." The man replied, "I wanted to do as you were doing because I saw you doing that."

Mu'adh then said, "The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to say: 'We have been commanded to remove any obstacle from the path of a Muslim. Whatever good deed is written for such a person, Allah will multiply it and give him a great reward.'"

Ja'bir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Beware of the Fire even if it were by as much as a mustard seed, for Allah will protect whoever removes an obstacle from the path of Muslims. Whatever good deed is written for such a person, Allah will multiply it and give him a great reward."

Then Mu'adh recited: "Indeed, Allah does not wrong anyone by so much as the weight of an atom, but if there is [any] good in it, He will multiply it and give from Himself a great reward." (Qur'an 4:40)

Ja'bir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Beware of the Fire even if it were by as much as a mustard seed. Whoever removes an obstacle from the path of Muslims, Allah will protect him and what he did."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله ... إتقوا النار ولو بشق تمرة نمن اتقى النار ولو بشق تمرة وقاه الله ثىر مااتقى
text_en: Abu Ubaidah reported from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Messenger of Allah said: "Fear the Fire, even if it is with a date being cut in half. Whoever fears the Fire, even if it is with a date being cut in half, will be saved."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله قكلإةه يقول »إن الله أرحم بعباده المؤ منين من الوالسدة الرحيمة بولدها ( . (٩٩٢١ جابر بن زيسد عن رسول اللسه عكلظإنةه انه نسال »لايزنى الزانى حين يزني وهو مسؤمن ( قسال رجل ياأبا الشعثاء يزنى وهو مسؤمن نال والله لسو أدركك عسمر ابن الخطاب رضى الله عنه لجلسدك الحد حين تقذف ولى الله بالزنى تال الله عز وجل في كتابه »إن الله يدافع عن الذين آمنسوا (.
text_en:
Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "Indeed, Allah is more compassionate to His believing servants than a mother to her child." 

Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Messenger of Allah said: "The fornicator does not fornicate while he is in a state of trust (i.e., married)." A man asked him, 'O Messenger of Allah, what about a man who fornicates while he is in a state of trust?' He replied, 'May God protect you from that.' 

A man said to Ibn Umar: 'Father of the two Sha'thahs, I have committed fornication while I am in a state of trust.' He replied, 'By Allah, I will not be present when you are stoned. By Allah, I will not be present when you are stoned.' 

Allah's Messenger said: "Indeed, Allah defends those who believe."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله ... لايزنى الزانى حين يزني وهو مسؤمن
text_en: Abu Ubaidah narrated from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Messenger of Allah said: "The adulterer is not punished when he commits adultery, but rather when he is caught and proven guilty."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: ( جابر بن زيسد عن رسول الله عتلتة انه سأله رجل نقال له يارسول الل من أثسد الناس بلاء نسال االأنبياء ثم المؤمنون ثم الانضل نالأنضل (٢١ ثم يبتنى العبد على قدر ذلك «٠)٩٤ ٩( جابر بن زيد عن النبى عكلنه تال »لايتمن أحدكم الموت ولا يدع به دا( خ صنعك ٢١ خ من ٣١ خ حنى إلا أن يكون ند وثق بعمله
text_en: Jabir bin Zayd reported that a man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "O Messenger of Allah, which people are afflicted with the greatest calamity? We ask the prophets, then the believers, and then the hypocrites." He said, "The servant is recompensed according to that.

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله ... لايتمن أحدكم الموت ولا يدع به
text_en: Abu Ubaidah reported from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Messenger of Allah said: "None of you should wish for death, nor should he be so grieved by it."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى عللاة قال »الايمان أثبت فى قلوب آهله من الجبال الرواسى على نرارها (.
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Faith is more firmly established in the hearts of its people than a mountain is firmly rooted on its foundation."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى عللاه أنه تال امثل قلب المؤمن كمثل المرآة المتجلية لايأتيه الشيطان من وجه إلا أبصره ومثل قلب المؤمن كمثل الفضة الجيدة إذا آدخلت النار وأحميت لم تزدد إلا خيرا . )٩٩٧ جابر بن زيد عن علنله قال االإيمان قيد الفتك لايفتك مؤمن( النبى
text_en:
Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "The heart of a believer is like a polished mirror. When Satan comes to it from any direction, he sees him and is recognized by him. The heart of a believer is like good silver when put in fire; it only increases in goodness." 

Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Faith is a trust (qiyad al-fatq) which does not betray a believer."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله ... إيمان قيد الفتك لايفتك مؤمن
text_en: Abu Ubayda related from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Messenger of Allah said: "Faith is a trust (amānāt) that does not bind a believer."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى يلنة تال اعجبت من المؤمن ومنزلته عند ربه إذا أحسن قبل منه وإذا أساء غفر له«.
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet Muhammad said: "I was pleased with the believer and his station before Allah, whether he does good or commits a fault, for Allah forgives him."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى ومتظاته نال »مامن عبد خرج من ذل ابليس إى عز الله إلا أعطاه الله ثلاثا اليسر من كثرة والغنى من غير مال والعلم من غير تعلم ( ا جابر بن زيد عن النبى علته قال »مامن عبد زهد في الدنيسا إلا أثبت الله الحكمة فى قلبه وأنطق بها لسانه وبصره عيوب الدنيا وداءها ودواءها وأخرجه منها سالماً إ لى دار السلام . )١٠٠١( جسابر بن زيد عن النبى علنة قسال »مامنكم من أحد يدخل الجنة إلا بعمل صالح وبرحمة الله وشفاعتى(
text_en:
Jabir bin Zayd reported from the Prophet ﷺ: "No servant of Allah departs from the abode of Iblis except that Allah gives him three things: ease in abundance, wealth without possessions, and knowledge without seeking it."

Jabir bin Zayd reported from the Prophet ﷺ: "There is no one among you who will enter Paradise except by doing good deeds and through the mercy of Allah and my intercession."

Jabir bin Zayd reported from the Prophet ﷺ: "No servant of yours will enter Paradise except by doing righteous actions and through the mercy of Allah and my intercession."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد عن رسول الله ... مامنكم من أحد يدخل الجنة إلا بعمل صالح وبرحمة الله
text_en: Abu Ubaidah related from Jabir ibn Zayd that the Messenger of Allah said: "There is not one among you who enters Paradise except by virtue of righteous deeds and the mercy of Allah."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: ١( جسابر بن زيد عن النبي عللة نسال »لاتنال )ا( شفاعتى سلطاناً ( غشوما للناس درجلا " لايراقب الله ي اليتيم ٠ )١٠٠٣( جسابر بن زيد عن النبي لإته قسال »لاتنال شىفاعتي الغالى في الدين ولا الجافى عنه ( ٤ ٠ ٠ ١ _ جابر بن زيد عن النبى تتلتة قال اليست الشفاعة لأهل الكبائر يحلف من أمتي ( جابر عند ذلك ما لأهل الكبائر شفاعة لأن الله قد أوعد أهل الكبائر النار في كتابه جاء وان الحديث عن أنس بن مالك أن الشفساعة لأهل الكبائر فوالله (٧١ ماعنى القتل والزنى والسحر وما أوعد الله عليه النار وذكر ان أنس بن مالك يقول ٠ انكم لنعملون أعمالاً هي أدق في أعينكم من الشعر ماكنا نعدها على عهد رسول الله عكلنة إلا من الكبائر حديث الشفاعة وذكر لنا فى ان أهل الايمان يحبسون ني الموقف بعد مابشروا 9( عند الموت وبعد ماأجابوا عند المحنة ني القبور ان الله ربهم قد غفر وأخذهم كتبهم بايمانهم وابيضت وجوههم وثقلت مسوازينهم وأراد الله أن يدخلهم الجنة بالشفاعة والشفاعة مخزونة لايصل اليها نبى ولا ملك حتى يفتحها رسول الله علنة تال والأنبياء )ا( ومن اتبعهم محبوسون والأولون والآخرون تال فبينما هم كذلك فيقولون الو استثسفعنا إلى ربنا نيريحنا من هذا المقام « فيقول بعضهم لبعض »عليكم بآدم فيأتونه فيقولون »أنت الذي خلقك الله بيده ونفخ فيك من روحه وأسجد لك ملائكته فلو استثسفعت لنا إلى ربك نيريحنا من هذا المقام ( فيقول إنى أكلت من الشجرة التى نهانى الله عنها وإني أستحيي من لقاء ربى ولكن عليكم بنوح نإن أول نبى أرسله الله« فيأتون نوحا فيقولون لو استشفعت لنا إلى ربك فيقول إني سألت ربى ماليس لي به علم وأنا أستحيى من لقاء ربي ولكن عليكم بإبراهيم خليل الرحمن فيأتونه فيقولون له لو استثمفعت لنا إلى ربك فيقول إني أستحيى من لقاء ربى ولكن عليكم بموسى كليم الله فيأتونه فيقولون له لو استشفعت لنا إلى ربك فيقول إنى قتلت نفسا نأنا استحى من لقاء ربي ولكن عليكم بعيسى نانه روح الله وكلمته فيأتونه نيقولون ناعله والمعنى بعد ان بشرتهم الملانكة عند الموت وعند المحنة في القبر بان الله قد غفر لهم. )١( خ تابمهم من المؤمنين
text_en:
Jabir bin Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "My intercession (shafā‘ah) will not benefit anyone except those who have committed grave sins." 

Jabir said, "The Prophet then explained, 'There is no intercession for those who have committed major sins because Allah has decreed in His Book that they will be punished with the Fire.'" 

Anas bin Mālik reported that the Prophet said: "Intercession (shafā‘ah) will not benefit anyone except those who have committed grave sins." The Prophet then said, "By Allah, I do not know of any intercession for those who have committed major sins, such as murder, adultery, sorcery, or what Allah has decreed to punish with the Fire."

Anas bin Mālik said: "You will certainly commit deeds that are more grievous in your eyes than hair growth." 

He mentioned that the Prophet said: "The intercession (shafā‘ah) is a treasured thing that no prophet or angel can reach until the Messenger of Allah opens it."

Anas bin Mālik reported that the Prophet said: "When the believers are about to die, they will say, 'O Lord, we have been wronged in this world.' Some of them will say to others, 'Go to Adam and ask him for intercession (shafā‘ah) on our behalf.'"

They will go to Adam and say, "You were created by Allah's Hand and He breathed His Spirit into you. The angels prostrated before you. If you can intercede for us with your Lord, we will be relieved from this place."

Adam will say, "I ate from the forbidden tree that Allah forbade me from eating. I am afraid to meet my Lord. But go to Noah, the first prophet sent by Allah."

They will go to Noah and say, "If you can intercede for us with your Lord, we will be relieved from this place." 

Noah will say, "I have asked my Lord about that which I do not know, and I am afraid to meet Him. But go to Abraham, the Friend of the Merciful."

They will go to Abraham and say, "If you can intercede for us with your Lord, we will be relieved from this place." 

Abraham will say, "I am afraid to meet my Lord. But go to Moses, the Speaker of Allah."

They will go to Moses and say, "If you can intercede for us with your Lord, we will be relieved from this place." 

Moses will say, "I killed a person who was not guilty of killing anyone. I am afraid to meet my Lord. But go to Jesus, the Spirit of Allah and His Word."

They will go to Jesus and say, "We have been informed by the angels that you are the one we should ask for intercession." 

Jesus will say, "I am the servant of Allah. Go back to your people and tell them that Allah has forgiven them."

The Prophet said: "This is what will happen when the believers die and face their Lord in the grave. Allah will have forgiven them and taken their deeds into account according to their faith. Their faces will be radiant, and their scales will be heavy." 

Allah will say, "I will admit them into Paradise through intercession (shafā‘ah), which is a treasured thing that no prophet or angel can reach until the Messenger of Allah opens it."

The Prophet said: "The first to enter Paradise will be those who have followed the prophets and the righteous ones."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبي لإته قسال »لاتنال شىفاعتي الغالى في الدين ولا الجافى عنه ( ٤ ٠ ٠ ١ _
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "My intercession will not benefit anyone who has been arrogant in his faith or turned away from it."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر بن زيد عن النبى تتلتة قال اليست الشفاعة لأهل الكبائر يحلف من أمتي (
text_en: Jabir ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: "Is intercession not for the people of major sins? He will be sworn in by my nation."

source: al-Jāmiʿ al-Ṣaḥīḥ — Musnad al-Imām al-Rabīʿ b. Ḥabīb
text_ar: جابر عند ذلك ما لأهل الكبائر شفاعة لأن الله قد أوعد أهل الكبائر النار في كتابه جاء وان الحديث عن أنس بن مالك أن الشفساعة لأهل الكبائر فوالله (٧١ ماعنى القتل والزنى والسحر وما أوعد الله عليه النار وذكر ان أنس بن مالك يقول ٠ انكم لنعملون أعمالاً هي أدق في أعينكم من الشعر ماكنا نعدها على عهد رسول الله عكلنة إلا من الكبائر حديث الشفاعة وذكر لنا فى ان أهل الايمان يحبسون ني الموقف بعد مابشروا 9( عند الموت
text_en: Jabir said, "There is no intercession for the people of major sins because Allah has decreed in His Book that those who commit major sins will be thrown into the Fire. Anas ibn Malik reported that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, 'By Allah, I do not know whether there will be any intercession for the people of major sins; indeed, what is meant by major sins are murder, adultery, sorcery, and whatever Allah has threatened with the Fire.' Anas ibn Malik also said, 'You will certainly commit deeds that you consider to be minor in your eyes, just as we used to consider them minor during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. However, except for major sins, there is intercession.' The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ mentioned that the people of faith will love one another until they meet their Lord at the time of death."
